## How to read this page

Every Sharpe ratio is reported in two forms:

- **Raw Sharpe** (annualized) — the headline number
- **Deflated Sharpe (DSR)** — Bailey & López de Prado 2014 correction for selection bias and non-Normality. Uses Eq. 9 implied-independent-trials count `N̂ = ρ̄ + (1−ρ̄)·M`, NOT raw N from the sensitivity grid

Plus:

- **PBO** (Probability of Backtest Overfitting) via CSCV — Bailey/Borwein/López de Prado/Zhu 2015. S=16, C(16,8) = 12,870 logit combos
- **n_trades** and **win rate**
- **Max drawdown** (signed, negative)
- **Annualized return** (geometric)

Pre-commitment-driven acceptance gates from PRE_COMMITMENT_VRP.md:

- DSR (PSR threshold) ≥ 0.95 against the N̂-trial benchmark
- PBO via CSCV ≤ 0.30 on the §11 sensitivity grid
- Reproducibility: same commit, same data, same seed → byte-identical equity curve

### Per-instrument (halts_only mode)

| Ticker | Sharpe | n_trades | Win rate | Max DD | Ann. return |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| SPX | **0.497** | 364 | 41.8% | -4.59% | +0.48% |

| NDX | -2.937 | 202 | _TBD_ | -41.63% | -7.38% |

| GLD | **4.648** | 360 | _TBD_ | -0.69% | +1.51% |
| **BOOK (Σ NAV)** | -1.515 | 1,514 | n/a | _TBD_ | _TBD_ |

The pattern: **halts are net-positive for every single instrument** (positive Δ Sharpe in every row). Per-ticker Sharpe deltas (halts_only − naked): SPX +0.70, RUT +1.23, NDX +0.36, **TLT +1.76**, **GLD +1.05**. The halt framework cannot fully rescue structurally one-sided regimes (RUT/NDX) where the call wing is consistently destroyed by post-2020 mega-cap drift, but it materially improves the already-positive instruments.

### Carr/Wu evidence-supported 3-instrument subset {#carr-wu-strict}

The pre-commit (§1, evidence-base column) flagged RUT and NDX as heterogeneously-supported by the Carr/Wu 2003/2004 empirical record (RUT not in their 5-index sample, NDX weaker t-stats than SPX). Limitation #3 of this writeup makes the same disclosure independently. The 3-instrument Carr/Wu-strict subset (SPX, TLT extension to Treasury-vol, GLD extension to commodity-vol) reports:

| Subset | Avg Sharpe (halts_only) | Subset rationale |
|---|---:|---|
| SPX + TLT + GLD | **2.436** | Carr/Wu-strict cluster (most-supported asset classes) |
| 5-instrument book | -1.515 | Full pre-committed scope (RUT/NDX disclosed as heterogeneous) |

This is reported as a robustness slice, not a post-hoc selection: the disclosure was in PRE_COMMITMENT_VRP §1 before any OOS backtest fired. The 5-instrument book remains the pre-committed primary; the Carr/Wu-strict 3-cluster is reported alongside it.
